about.meta_description: Learn about Ammayu Waktole's systems engineering journey, background, core values, and verified IT certifications.
about.keywords: Ammayu Waktole history, DevOps timeline, IT certifications, AWS architect, RHCSA Linux
about.body_text: Hi, I'm Ammayu — an IT Support and Network Engineer with experience across banking technology, payment systems, enterprise infrastructure, and digital transformation. From Mastercard implementations and ATM networks to Microsoft 365, Azure, and network operations, I enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building reliable systems that keep businesses connected.
about.body_text_2: Today, as an independent consultant, I partner with companies to review infrastructure security, streamline deployments, and write automation tools. I bridge the gap between technical complexity and business growth.
